newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SPH, Lum Chang to buy property.
newsitem.headline: SPH, Lum Chang to buy property.

text.p: Singapore Press Holdings Ltd and Lum Chang Holdings Ltd said on Wendesday they would jointly buy the Promenade shopping complex in Singapore for Singapore $270.87 million.

The two companies said in separate statements released simultaneously that the seven-storey complex in Singapore's fashionable Orchard Road shopping area would be bought via a 50-50 joint venture company, called Newco.
Newco had paid a deposit of S$27.09 million for the property and would pay the balance no later than January 15, 1997.

Lum Chang said it planned to finance its share of the purchase, amounting to S$135.43 million, from internal resources and external borrowings. It said the deal would not materially affect its net tangible assets per share or its expected earnings for the financial year to June 30, 1997.
SPH said its share of the purchase would also be financed by internal and external borrowings and that the deal would not materially impact its earnings per share for the year to August 31, 1997.
"The acquisition is a long-term investment," the SPH statement said.
